game_concept: A strategy race set in Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch, a lookout against wolves: the snow ranger must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Vault: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the watch bell.
theme: Snowy Hold – Wolf Watch: a lookout against wolves
core_gameplay_loop: In Wolf Watch, repeat each round: Use return to send a computed value back to the caller and open the watch bell. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the snow ranger ahead. Then check the vault value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the watch bell by solving code steps involving vault that move the snow ranger forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the watch bell first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Return Vault
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Vault' (Week 6 slot 3), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Wolf Watch'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against icicle bats in Wolf Watch.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
